validity_findings.finding: 30/30 perfect and 9/9 held-out success is expected given design: derived_context is bound from expected_template with params then parsed back; observation-derived state directly encodes answer (Authorization Bearer header, token body field, X-Permission header, url_query permission). RECONSTRUCTION-RULE succeeds by generic adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry logic (choose_adoption sorted alphabetically) and rewrite_template that transcribes observed key with ${param} substitution. Held-out novel forms (X-Api-Key, X-Auth-Key, Api-Token, api_token, authToken, access_key, permission, access_scope, X-Scope) require no table lookup beyond adoption, so 9/9 does not demonstrate learned generalization beyond copy mechanism. Synthetic-to-real gap remains dominant unknown; minimal derived dict lacks AX tree heterogeneity, visual layout, timing, auth/session nuance. Producer discloses this and bounds claim to synthetic orthogonal only.

claim_ceiling: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST is justified ONLY as a narrow bounded proof-of-concept: genuine rule-based structural reconstruction (reconstruct_resolve with softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80, conditioned solely on intent + observation-derived state from synthetic url/headers_observed/body_observed) achieves alias-OOD 30/30 correct (1.0 Wilson [0.886,1.0], binomial p=1e-30 vs 0.10, McNemar p=1.19e-07 vs B-EXACT-MATCH, false_accept 0.0 vs verbatim 1.0 gap 1.0 p=1.19e-07) on synthetic orthogonal header (ApiKey/X-Reset-Token/Authorization -> X-Api-Key/X-Auth-Key/Api-Token) / body JSON field (apiKey/key/token -> api_token/authToken/access_key) / auth permission (scope/admin_scope/X-Permission -> permission/access_scope/X-Scope) families, including held-out 9/9 novel forms, with exact-match 12/12 and no-applicable precision 1.0/ECE 0.0758 (bimodal, sparse bins) and channel-isolated credit (headers-only 20/30, body-only 10/30). No evidence supports generalization to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees (0 tasks attempted, substrate unavailable), to learned GRPO/System-One adapter (unavailable, no training cost/stability/ECE non-inferiority measured), to production SPAs / mixed multi-channel aliasing within one request / session/drift / visual DOM signals, or to product economics at scale. Synthetic observation directly encodes answer by construction; 1.0 reflects trivial copy of observed credential key, not robustness to noisy real DOM/AX. Not PRODUCT_CORE. Next required falsifiers: live BrowserGym replication with real AX at 1280x720, learned adapter 3-seed training vs rule proxy, and test of mixed-channel aliasing and production SPA heterogeneity.
